47 Powers of entry, search and seizure: supplementary provision

(1) A relevant enforcement officer may use reasonable force, if necessary, for the purpose
of exercising any power conferred by sections 36 to 45.

(2) A person authorised under section 40(5) to accompany a relevant enforcement officer
may use reasonable force, if necessary, for the purpose of exercising any power
conferred by sections 39 to 45.

(3) The powers conferred on a relevant enforcement officer by any of sections 36 to 45
do not affect any powers exercisable by the officer apart from that section.
